title: Aubin's Drills
description: Adds drills to minecraft, just like in satisfactory.
body:
# ❓ What is this mod about?
This mod adds drills, and wood cutters.
Drills mine ores, **on the ore veins**. They mine ore infinitely, just like in satisfactory. But, it drops the ore on the floor, just like the wood cutter.
Wood cutter does basically what it's called, it cuts wood infinitely.
The drill has a cooldown of ~20 seconds, while the wood cutter has ~15 seconds.
This, of course, will be tweaked in the future.

# ⚠️ WARNING
**This mod can and will cause performance issues if the drill/cutter stays activated, but the loot doesn't get transported (ex: in a chest/with a hopper), to solve this, you can just remove your cutter/drill, and put it only if you're close to it. **
